decisions.marketRead: The EGX30 is displaying strong upward momentum, driven by stellar performance in the Basic Materials and Energy sectors over the past 20 days. Given our semi-long-term philosophy and starting capital, we are initiating a position in AMOC to capture high momentum in the Energy sector while maintaining a prudent cash buffer and respecting concentration limits.

proposedActions.rationale: Initiating a high-conviction position to capture strong short and medium-term momentum in the Energy sector, well within our single position size limit.
